_readme: Christmas Drip Booth. Outfits and locations for the clothe swap. 'free': true means free players can use it. 'prompt' is what the AI image model (OpenAI, see OPENAI_API_KEY in README) is told to dress the player in, and where to place them. Be specific about fabric, colour and light; it makes the pictures beautiful. The drawn Studio versions live in public/swap.js, keyed by id. Edit freely and restart.

outfits.name: IJGB Christmas Sweater
outfits.blurb: The knit wey dem carry come from abroad
outfits.prompt: a cosy, chunky hand-knitted red Christmas sweater with crisp white Fair Isle bands of snowflakes and zigzags, ribbed crew neck and cuffs, and the words DETTY 26 knitted across the chest in white

outfits.name: Father Christmas
outfits.blurb: Red suit, white fur, Santa hat
outfits.prompt: a luxurious deep-red velvet Father Christmas suit with thick fluffy white fur trim down the front and on the collar, a wide black leather belt with a polished gold buckle, and a matching red velvet Santa hat with a white fur band and pom-pom (no fake beard)

outfits.name: Royal Agbada
outfits.blurb: Wide agbada with gold embroidery and fila
outfits.prompt: a majestic, flowing royal-blue Yoruba agbada in rich damask fabric with dense hand-stitched gold embroidery around a deep V neckline, worn over a matching buba, with a matching royal-blue fila cap with a gold band, worn proudly like a chief at an owambe

outfits.name: Aso-ebi and Gele
outfits.blurb: Owambe lace with a big gold gele
outfits.prompt: an elegant coral and gold French-lace owambe aso-ebi blouse with scattered sequins and beaded neckline, and a large, sculpted, perfectly pleated metallic-gold gele head tie standing tall like a crown, with tasteful gold earrings

outfits.name: Ankara Blazer
outfits.blurb: Sharp ankara blazer, white shirt, bow tie
outfits.prompt: a sharply tailored slim-fit blazer in bold orange, teal and yellow Ankara wax print with black satin lapels, a crisp white shirt, a black silk bow tie and a gold pocket square

outfits.name: Black Senator
outfits.blurb: Clean senator kaftan with gold trim
outfits.prompt: a sleek, perfectly pressed black Nigerian senator kaftan with a mandarin collar, fine gold embroidery running down the front placket and a small chest pocket, clean and expensive-looking

outfits.name: Ankara Gown
outfits.blurb: Off-shoulder print gown with puff sleeves
outfits.prompt: a glamorous off-shoulder Ankara print gown in magenta, gold and emerald green with dramatic structured puff sleeves, a fitted bodice and statement gold jewellery

outfits.name: Naija Jersey
outfits.blurb: Green and white, for the Detty Cup
outfits.prompt: a modern green and white Nigerian football style jersey with a bold chevron pattern across the chest and the number 26, breathable sports fabric, with no real brand logos or crests

locations.name: Christmas Tree Plaza
locations.blurb: The big tree, lit up at night
locations.prompt: standing in front of a huge, beautifully lit Christmas tree in a city plaza at night, covered in warm golden fairy lights and red ornaments, with dreamy bokeh lights and wrapped gifts around its base

locations.name: Detty Studio
locations.prompt: a professional fashion photo studio with a deep emerald-green seamless backdrop, soft gold bokeh lights and subtle gold confetti, lit like a magazine cover shoot

locations.name: Lagos Lagoon by Night
locations.prompt: the Lagos lagoon waterfront at night, with a long illuminated bridge and the glittering Lagos city skyline reflected in the dark water, warm city lights glowing, cinematic and glamorous

locations.name: Beach at Sunset
locations.prompt: a beautiful Lagos beach at golden-hour sunset, with leaning palm trees, gentle waves and a glowing orange and pink sky, warm sunlight on the face

locations.name: Owambe Hall
locations.prompt: a glamorous Nigerian owambe party hall with draped gold and ivory fabric ceilings, sparkling crystal chandeliers, curtains of fairy lights and elegantly dressed round tables, luxurious and festive

locations.name: Village Christmas
locations.blurb: Home for Christmas, red earth and mango tree
locations.prompt: a warm Nigerian village compound on Christmas day in soft afternoon light, red earth, a cream bungalow with a zinc roof, a big leafy mango tree, colourful Christmas bunting and a happy homecoming feeling

locations.name: Welcome Home Arrival
locations.prompt: a bright, modern airport arrival hall with tall glass windows, a plane visible on the tarmac outside, and a green WELCOME HOME sign overhead, the joyful moment of landing home for December

locations.name: Winter Abroad
locations.blurb: Snowy street, for the IJGB story
locations.prompt: a snowy European city street at dusk with gently falling snow, warm glowing lamp posts and lit shop windows, magical winter atmosphere
